paragraphs: Hanmi Financial Corporation ("Hanmi Financial," the "Company," "we," "us" or "our") is a Delaware corporation incorporated in 2000 to be the holding company for Hanmi Bank (the "Bank") and is subject to the Bank Holding Company Act of 1956, as amended (the "BHCA"). Our principal office is located at 900 Wilshire Boulevard, Suite 1250, Los Angeles, California 90017, and our telephone number is (213) 382-2200.

Hanmi Bank, the primary subsidiary of Hanmi Financial, is a state-chartered bank incorporated under the laws of the State of California in 1981, and licensed pursuant to the California Financial Code. The Bank's deposit accounts are insured under the Federal Deposit Insurance Act up to applicable limits thereof. The California Department of Financial Protection and Innovation (the "DFPI") is the Bank's primary state bank regulator and the FDIC is its primary federal regulator. The Bank's headquarters are located at 3660 Wilshire Boulevard, Penthouse Suite A, Los Angeles, California 90010.

The Bank is a community bank conducting general business banking, with its primary market encompassing the Korean-American community and other multi-ethnic communities across California, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Texas, Virginia and Washington. The Bank's full-service offices are located in markets where many of the businesses are owned by immigrants and other minority groups. The Bank's client base reflects the multi-ethnic composition of these communities.

The Bank's revenues are derived primarily from interest and fees on loans, interest and dividends on securities and other interest-earning assets, service charges and fees on deposit accounts and sales of SBA and mortgage loans.

The Bank historically has provided its banking services through its branch network to a wide variety of small- to medium-sized businesses. Throughout the Bank's service areas, competition is intense for both loans and deposits. While the market for banking services is dominated by a few nationwide banks with many offices operating over wide geographic areas, the Bank's primary competitors are other community banks that focus their marketing efforts on Korean-American and other multi-ethnic businesses in the Bank's service areas.

The Bank originates loans for its own portfolio and for sale in the secondary market. Lending activities include real estate loans (commercial property, construction and residential property), commercial and industrial loans (commercial term, commercial lines of credit and international), equipment lease financing and SBA loans.

paragraphs: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, net income was $76.1 million, $62.2 million and $80.0 million, respectively. The increase of $13.9 million, or 22.3%, in net income for the year ended December 31, 2025 as compared with the year ended December 31, 2024, reflects a $33.4 million increase in net interest income and a $2.4 million increase in noninterest income, offset by a $6.5 million increase in noninterest expense and a $5.4 million increase in income tax expense.

The decrease of $17.8 million, or 22.3%, in net income for the year ended December 31, 2024 as compared with the year ended December 31, 2023, reflects an $18.5 million decrease in net interest income, a $2.6 million decrease in noninterest income, and a $4.8 million increase in noninterest expense, offset by an $8.1 million decrease in income tax expense.
For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, our earnings per diluted share were $2.51, $2.05 and $2.62, respectively.
Additional significant financial highlights include:

• Loans increased by $312.0 million, or 5.0%, to $6.56 billion as of December 31, 2025, compared with $6.25 billion as of December 31, 2024. The net increase was due to loan production of $1.62 billion, offset by payoffs, loan sales, and prepayments of $1.31 billion.

• Credit loss expense increased by $10.0 million, to $14.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared with $4.4 million for the year ended December 31, 2024. The increase was primarily due to an $8.6 million charge-off during 2025.

• Securities decreased $25.2 million to $880.6 million at December 31, 2025 from $905.8 million at December 31, 2024. The decrease was primarily attributable to $233.3 million in maturities and payments, partially offset by $173.1 million in purchases and a $37.6 million decline in net unrealized losses.

• Deposits were $6.68 billion at December 31, 2025 compared with $6.44 billion at December 31, 2024 as money market and savings deposits and time deposits increased by $150.7 million and $178.1 million, respectively, while interest-bearing and non-interest bearing demand deposits decreased by $5.5 million and $81.4 million, respectively.
• Borrowings decreased $112.5 million to $150.0 million at December 31, 2025 compared with $262.5 million at December 31, 2024.
• Cash dividends were $1.08, $1.00, and $1.00 per share of common stock for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, respectively.

• Return on average assets and return on average stockholders' equity for the year ended December 31, 2025 were 0.98% and 9.32%, respectively, as compared with 0.83% and 7.97%, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2024, and 1.08% and 10.70%, respectively, for the year ended December 31, 2023.

paragraphs: Hanmi Financial Corporation ("Hanmi Financial," the "Company," "we," "us" or "our") 為一間在德克薩斯州註冊的公司，於2000年成立，作為Hanmi Bank（"Bank"）的控股公司，並受1956年銀行控股公司法案（"BHCA"）及其修正案之規範。本公司主要辦公室位於900 Wilshire Boulevard, Suite 1250, Los Angeles, California 90017，電話號碼為(213) 382-2200。

Hanmi Bank, the primary subsidiary of Hanmi Financial, 是一家州立銀行，於1981年根據加州法律註冊成立，並根據加州金融法典取得許可。該銀行的存款帳戶根據《聯邦存款保險法》投保，投保額度以適用之限額為準。加州金融保護與創新部（"DFPI"）為該銀行的主要州級銀行監管機構，而FDIC為其主要聯邦監管機構。該銀行總部位於加州洛杉磯Wilshire Boulevard 3660號，Penthouse Suite A，郵遞區號90010。
該銀行為一間社區銀行，從事一般商業銀行業務，其主要市場涵蓋韓國裔美國人社區及其他多民族社區，包括加州、科羅拉多州、喬治亞州、伊利諾州、新澤西州、紐約州、德克薩斯州、維吉尼亞州及華盛頓州。該銀行的全服務辦公室位於許多企業為移民及其他少數族裔所擁有之市場。該銀行的客戶羣體反映這些社區的多民族組成。
該銀行的營業收入主要來自貸款的利息及費用、證券的利息及股息、及其他利息產生資產、存款賬戶的服務費用及費用，以及SBA及房貸貸款的銷售。

本銀行歷來透過其分行網路為廣泛的小規模至中規模企業提供銀行服務。在本銀行服務區域內，貸款與存款的競爭都非常激烈。雖然銀行服務市場由幾家全國性銀行主導，這些銀行在廣泛的地理區域內設有多個分行，但本銀行的主要競爭對手是其他社區銀行，這些銀行專注於在本銀行服務區域內的韓國裔美國人及其他多民族企業的市場推廣。
本銀行為其自有資產組合及在二級市場銷售而發放貸款。貸款業務包括不動產貸款（商業不動產、建設及住宅不動產）、商業及工業貸款（商業期貸、商業信用線及國際貸款）、設備租賃融資及 SBA 拆售貸款。

paragraphs: 淨收入於2024年12月31日財年較2023年12月31日財年減少22.3%，即減少17.8 百萬美元，反映淨利息收入減少18.5 百萬美元、非利息收入減少2.6 百萬美元，以及非利息費用增加4.8 百萬美元，抵銷收入稅費用減少8.1 百萬美元。
會計年度終了日為2025年12月31日、2024年12月31日及2023年12月31日，本公司每股稀釋後盈餘為2.51美元、2.05美元及2.62美元，分別。
其他重要財務亮點包括：
• 應收帳款增加 312.0 百萬美元，或 5.0%，至 6.56 十億美元，截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，相較於 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 6.25 十億美元。淨增加係因貸款產生 1.62 十億美元，抵銷貸款償還、貸款出售及預先償還 1.31 十億美元。
• 資產減損費用增加 10.0 百萬美元，至 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度為 14.4 百萬美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 4.4 百萬美元增加。此增加主要係因 2025 年發生 8.6 百萬美元的核銷費用。
• 有價證券減少 25.2 百萬美元，至 2025 年 12 月 31 日為 880.6 百萬美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 905.8 百萬美元減少。減少主要係因 233.3 百萬美元的到期與支付，部分抵銷 173.1 百萬美元的購入以及 37.6 百萬美元的淨未實現虧損減少。
• 借款減少 112.5 百萬美元，至 2025 年 12 月 31 日為 150.0 百萬美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 262.5 百萬美元減少。
• 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度、2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度及 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度，普通股每股現金股息為 1.08 美元、1.00 美元及 1.00 美元。
• 2025 年 12 月 31 日止年度，平均資產回報率及平均股東權益回報率分別為 0.98% 及 9.32%，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 0.83% 及 7.97%，以及 2023 年 12 月 31 日止年度的 1.08% 及 10.70% 有所減少。
